tasks.originating_goal: Convert HydraSafe frameworks into bounded facility-level permitting-readiness engagements.
tasks.collision_boundary: This claim owns customer research, outreach, commercial conversion, and first reference engagement. It does not own HydraSafe security-control implementation.
tasks.release_condition: First engagement is durably accepted or the canonical handoff reassigns the lane.
tasks.expected_evidence: outreach receipts, intake record, executed SOW, delivery acceptance, and reference-rights disposition

tasks.originating_goal: Make federal security requirements the minimum floor and exceed them.
tasks.collision_boundary: The workflow validates and receipts security controls but may not alter DiamondOps canonical liability documents or assume customer, PE, AHJ, insurer, OEM, owner, installer, operator, or OT authority.
tasks.release_condition: A completed workflow run validates the current main commit and publishes hydrasafe-validation-receipt-<sha> containing receipts/validation-receipt.json; failure remains BLOCKED or REVIEW_REQUIRED.
tasks.expected_evidence: workflow run, job result, logs, uploaded validation receipt artifact, and receipt commit SHA
tasks.blocked_reason: The connected workflow-run surface has not exposed a completed run for the latest main commit.
tasks.next_executable_action: GitHub Actions runs on the next main push or workflow_dispatch and uploads the deterministic receipt only after validation succeeds.
